_comment: Editor-coded positions that fill gaps left by the search-limited research pass. Each entry is coded ONLY from a documented roll-call vote, official action, or explicit public statement, with the source linked. Entries never overwrite a stance already coded in the race file; they only fill null stances and append record items. Vote directions are taken from the official Florida Legislature bill pages (vote history tab) and congress.gov.

immigration.summary: Voted for the Laken Riley Act (2025), which requires federal detention of unauthorized immigrants charged with theft and certain other crimes, and has campaigned on continuing Florida's cooperation with federal deportation operations.
